description: Figure 7 presents the CoLeG-R values for scaling up the SFT dataset across various model scales within the LLaMA-2 family. The horizontal axis represents the dataset size, labeled “Acc”, with categories ordered as Acc1, Acc2, Acc3, Acc4, and Acc5. The vertical axis is labeled “CoLeG-R (%)” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Four colored lines represent different settings: “SFT on D1, D2” (blue), “SFT on D1, D2, D3” (orange), “SFT on D1, D2, D3, D4” (green), and “no SFT” (purple). The “no SFT” line begins at approximately 60% and remains relatively stable around 60-65% across all Acc values. The “SFT on D1, D2” line starts at approximately 55% and increases to around 70% at Acc5. The “SFT on D1, D2, D3” line begins at approximately 60% and rises to around 75% at Acc5. Finally, the “SFT on D1, D2, D3, D4” line starts at approximately 65% and reaches approximately 80% at Acc5. No bars are visually emphasized, and the lines are not sorted in any apparent order.
